Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

The team now has departments such as Billing and Technical Support. Let admins create, rename,
and delete groups, and add staff to more than one group. Staff can browse groups and memberships;
groups organize work, they don't hide tickets from other staff.

For example:

```http
POST /api/v1/groups

{"group":{"name":"Billing"}}
```

```http
POST /api/v1/group_memberships

{"group_membership":{"group_id":20,"user_id":12,"default":true}}
```

Use the usual list, detail, and delete routes for both resources, plus PATCH for group names.
List groups and memberships by ID ascending.
Let admins choose a staff member's default with `PUT /group_memberships/:id/make_default`.
Every staff member with memberships should have one default;
removing it should pick another remaining membership.
Filter memberships by `group_id` and `user_id`.

Tickets can now have a `group_id`, with the group's ID/name in `group`, and staff can filter the
inbox by group or `group_id=unassigned`.

An assigned person must belong to the ticket's group. Assigning someone to an ungrouped ticket
should use their default group, if they have one. Moving a ticket to another group should clear
an assignee who doesn't belong there. Clearing the assignee leaves the group in place; explicitly
clearing the group also clears the assignee. Deleting groups or memberships clears invalid assignments.
Suspension keeps memberships for later.

  has_many :tickets, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :account

  has_many :invitations, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :account

    uniqueness: { case_sensitive: false },
    format: {
      with: /\A[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\z/,
      message: "must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens"
    }

  scope :cancelled, -> { where.not(cancelled_at: nil) }
  scope :purgeable, -> { cancelled.where("cancelled_at < ?", REACTIVATION_WINDOW.ago) }

  def cancelled?
    cancelled_at.present?
  end

  def active?
    !cancelled?
  end

  def within_reactivation_window?
    cancelled? && cancelled_at >= REACTIVATION_WINDOW.ago
  end

  def cancel!
    transaction do
      update!(cancelled_at: Time.current)
      Session.where(user_id: users.select(:id)).delete_all
    end
  end

  def reactivate!
    update!(cancelled_at: nil)
  end

  def self.purge_cancelled!
    count = 0
    purgeable.find_each do |account|
      account.destroy!
      count += 1
    end
    count
  end
end

require "digest"
require "securerandom"

class User < ApplicationRecord
  ROLES = %w[admin agent customer].freeze
  EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL = 24.hours
  PASSWORD_RESET_TTL = 2.hours

  belongs_to :account
  has_many :sessions, dependent: :destroy
  has_many :requested_tickets, class_name: "Ticket", foreign_key: :requester_id, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :requester
  has_many :assigned_tickets, class_name: "Ticket", foreign_key: :assignee_id, dependent: :nullify, inverse_of: :assignee
  has_many :comments, foreign_key: :author_id, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :author
  has_many :sent_invitations, class_name: "Invitation", foreign_key: :invited_by_id, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :invited_by

  has_secure_password

  normalizes :name, with: ->(value) { value.strip }
  normalizes :email, with: ->(value) { value.strip.downcase }

  validates :name, presence: true
  validates :email,
    presence: true,
    format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP },
    uniqueness: { scope: :account_id, case_sensitive: false }
  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ROLES }
  validates :suspended, inclusion: { in: [ true, false ] }
  validates :password, length: { minimum: 6 }, if: -> { password.present? }

  scope :active, -> { where(suspended: false) }
  scope :suspended, -> { where(suspended: true) }
  scope :staff, -> { where(role: %w[admin agent]) }
  scope :ordered_by_id, -> { order(id: :asc) }

  def admin?
    role == "admin"
  end

  def agent?
    role == "agent"
  end

  def staff?
    admin? || agent?
  end

  def customer?
    role == "customer"
  end

  def active?
    !suspended?
  end

  def generate_email_verification_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    update!(
      email_verification_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      email_verification_sent_at: Time.current,
      email_verification_expires_at: EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL.from_now
    )
    raw_token
  end

  def self.find_by_email_verification_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    where("email_verification_expires_at > ?", Time.current)
      .find_by(email_verification_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def verify_email!
    update!(
      verified: true,
      verified_at: Time.current,
      email_verification_token_digest: nil,
      email_verification_expires_at: nil
    )
  end

  def generate_password_reset_token!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    update!(
      password_reset_token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      password_reset_sent_at: Time.current,
      password_reset_expires_at: PASSWORD_RESET_TTL.from_now
    )
    raw_token
  end

  def self.find_by_password_reset_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    where("password_reset_expires_at > ?", Time.current)
      .find_by(password_reset_token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def reset_password!(new_password)
    transaction do
      update!(
        password: new_password,
        password_reset_token_digest: nil,
        password_reset_expires_at: nil
      )
      sessions.delete_all
    end
  end

  def change_password!(new_password)
    transaction do
      update!(password: new_password)
      sessions.delete_all
    end
  end

  def revoke_access_and_clear_assignments!
    sessions.delete_all
    Ticket.where(account_id: account_id, assignee_id: id).update_all(assignee_id: nil)
  end

  def self.digest_token(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      rescue_from ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError do |_exception|
        render json: { error: "Invalid JSON payload" }, status: :bad_request
      end

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |exception|
        render json: { error: exception.message }, status: :bad_request
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound do |_exception|
        render json: { error: "Not found" }, status: :not_found
      end

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_user, :current_session

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          render json: { error: "X-Helpdesk-Account header is required" }, status: :bad_request
          return
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        return unless current_account

        if current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def authenticate_user!
        token = bearer_token
        if token.blank?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        session = Session.includes(:user).find_by_token(token)
        if session.nil? || session.user.account_id != current_account.id || !session.user.verified? || session.user.suspended?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_session = session
        @current_user = session.user
      end

      def require_admin!
        unless current_user&.admin?
          render json: { error: "Only account owners can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user&.staff?
          render json: { error: "Only staff can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def bearer_token
        auth = request.authorization.to_s
        match = auth.match(/\ABearer\s+(.+)\z/i)
        match&.[](1)&.strip
      end

      def paginate(scope)
        page = [ params[:page].to_i, 1 ].max
        raw_per_page = params[:per_page].to_i
        per_page = raw_per_page.positive? ? [ raw_per_page, 100 ].min : 25

        total_count = scope.count
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page
        records = scope.offset(offset).limit(per_page)

        next_page = (page * per_page < total_count) ? page + 1 : nil
        previous_page = page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: total_count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: next_page,
            previous_page: previous_page
          }
        }
      end

      def serialize_account(account)

          id: account.id,
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain,

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      rescue_from ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError do |_exception|
        render json: { error: "Invalid JSON payload" }, status: :bad_request
      end

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing do |exception|
        render json: { error: exception.message }, status: :bad_request
      end

      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound do |_exception|
        render json: { error: "Not found" }, status: :not_found
      end

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_user, :current_session

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          render json: { error: "X-Helpdesk-Account header is required" }, status: :bad_request
          return
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        return unless current_account

        if current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def authenticate_user!
        token = bearer_token
        if token.blank?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        session = Session.includes(:user).find_by_token(token)
        if session.nil? || session.user.account_id != current_account.id || !session.user.verified? || session.user.suspended?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_session = session
        @current_user = session.user
      end

      def require_admin!
        unless current_user&.admin?
          render json: { error: "Only account owners can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_staff!
        unless current_user&.staff?
          render json: { error: "Only staff can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def bearer_token
        auth = request.authorization.to_s
        match = auth.match(/\ABearer\s+(.+)\z/i)
        match&.[](1)&.strip
      end

      def paginate(scope)
        page = [ params[:page].to_i, 1 ].max
        raw_per_page = params[:per_page].to_i
        per_page = raw_per_page.positive? ? [ raw_per_page, 100 ].min : 25

        total_count = scope.count
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page
        records = scope.offset(offset).limit(per_page)

        next_page = (page * per_page < total_count) ? page + 1 : nil
        previous_page = page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: total_count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: next_page,
            previous_page: previous_page
          }
        }
      end

      def serialize_account(account)
        {
          id: account.id,
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain,
          cancelled: account.cancelled?,
          cancelled_at: account.cancelled_at,
          created_at: account.created_at,
          updated_at: account.updated_at
        }
      end

      def serialize_portal(account)
        {
          name: account.name,
          subdomain: account.subdomain
        }
      end

      def serialize_user(user)
        {
          id: user.id,
          account_id: user.account_id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role,
          verified: user.verified?,
          verified_at: user.verified_at,
          suspended: user.suspended?,
          created_at: user.created_at,
          updated_at: user.updated_at
        }
      end

      def serialize_staff_member(user)
        {
          id: user.id,
          name: user.name,
          email: user.email,
          role: user.role
        }
      end

      def serialize_invitation(invitation)
        {
          id: invitation.id,
          account_id: invitation.account_id,
          email: invitation.email,
          role: invitation.role,
          status: invitation.status,
          invited_by_id: invitation.invited_by_id,
          invited_by: {
            id: invitation.invited_by.id,
            name: invitation.invited_by.name,
            email: invitation.invited_by.email
          },
          expires_at: invitation.expires_at,
          sent_at: invitation.sent_at,
          accepted_at: invitation.accepted_at,
          revoked_at: invitation.revoked_at,
          created_at: invitation.created_at,
          updated_at: invitation.updated_at
        }
      end

      def serialize_request(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          created_at: ticket.created_at,
          updated_at: ticket.public_updated_at || ticket.updated_at
        }
      end

      def serialize_ticket(ticket)
        {
          id: ticket.id,
          subject: ticket.subject,
          status: ticket.status,
          priority: ticket.priority,
          requester_id: ticket.requester_id,
          requester: {
            id: ticket.requester.id,
            name: ticket.requester.name,
            email: ticket.requester.email
          },
          assignee_id: ticket.assignee_id,
          assignee: ticket.assignee ? {
            id: ticket.assignee.id,
            name: ticket.assignee.name
          } : nil,
          created_at: ticket.created_at,
          updated_at: ticket.updated_at
        }
      end

      def serialize_comment(comment)
        {
          id: comment.id,
          body: comment.body,
          public: comment.public,
          author: {
            id: comment.author.id,
            name: comment.author.name
          },
          created_at: comment.created_at
        }
      end
    end
  end

    return true if mail.mime_type.to_s.downcase == "multipart/report"

    auto_submitted_values = header_values("Auto-Submitted").map { |v| v.strip.downcase }
    return true if auto_submitted_values.any? { |v| v.present? && v != "no" }

    return true if LIST_HEADERS.any? { |name| header_values(name).any?(&:present?) }

    precedence_values = header_values("Precedence").map { |v| v.strip.downcase }
    return true if precedence_values.any? { |v| AUTOMATED_PRECEDENCE_VALUES.include?(v) }

    return true if AUTO_REPLY_HEADERS.any? { |name| header_values(name).any?(&:present?) }

    if mail.header["Return-Path"].present? && header_values("Return-Path").all?(&:blank?)
      return true
    end

    from_addr = safe_from_address
    if from_addr && from_addr.local.to_s.strip.match?(AUTOMATED_LOCAL_PART_PATTERN)

    end

    field = Array(mail.header[:from]).first
    return nil unless field

    element = field.respond_to?(:element) ? field.element : field.address_list
    element&.addresses&.first
  rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
    nil
  end

  def safe_recipient_addresses
    addresses = []

    %i[to cc bcc].each do |field_name|
      Array(mail.header[field_name]).each do |field|
        element = field.respond_to?(:element) ? field.element : field.address_list
        addresses.concat(Array(element&.addresses))
      rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
        next
      end
    end

    %i[x_original_to x_forwarded_to].each do |field_name|
      Array(mail.header[field_name]).each do |field|
        addresses << Mail::Address.new(field.to_s)
      rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
        next
      end
    end

    addresses
  end

  def extract_plain_text_body
    text = if mail.multipart?
      plain_part = find_part_by_mime_type(mail, "text/plain")
      if plain_part
        decode_part_text(plain_part)
      elsif (html_part = find_part_by_mime_type(mail, "text/html"))
        html_to_plain_text(decode_part_text(html_part))
      else
        ""
      end
    elsif mail.attachment?
      ""
    elsif mail.mime_type.nil? || mail.mime_type.downcase == "text/plain"
      decode_part_text(mail)
    elsif mail.mime_type.downcase == "text/html"
      html_to_plain_text(decode_part_text(mail))
    else
      ""
    end

    text.gsub(/\r\n?/, "\n").strip
  end

  def find_part_by_mime_type(part, target_mime_type)
    part.all_parts.find do |p|
      !p.attachment? && p.mime_type.to_s.downcase == target_mime_type
    end
  end

  def decode_part_text(part)
    raw = part.body.decoded.to_s
    charset = part.charset.presence || mail.charset.presence
    if charset && raw.encoding == Encoding::BINARY
      raw = raw.dup.force_encoding(Encoding.find(charset)) rescue raw
    end
    raw.encode("UTF-8", invalid: :replace, undef: :replace, replace: "")
  end

  def html_to_plain_text(html)
    with_breaks = html.gsub(/<\s*(?:br\s*\/?|\/p|\/div|\/li|\/tr)\s*>/i, "\n")
    stripped = ActionView::Base.full_sanitizer.sanitize(with_breaks)
    CGI.unescapeHTML(stripped.to_s)
  end

  end

  def process_new_ticket
    subject = mail.subject.to_s.strip
    if subject.blank?
      bounced!
      return
    end

    verification_token = nil
    created_user = nil

    Ticket.transaction do
      @target_account.lock!

      user = @target_account.users.find_by(email: @sender_email)
      if user
        raise InvalidDeliveryError if user.suspended?
      else
        user = @target_account.users.build(
          name: @sender_name,
          email: @sender_email,
          password: SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(24),
          role: "customer",
          verified: false
        )
        user.save!
        verification_token = user.generate_email_verification_token!
        created_user = user
      end

      ticket = @target_account.tickets.create!(
        requester: user,
        subject: subject,
        status: "open",
        origin: "email",
        email_message_id: inbound_email.message_id
      )

      comment = ticket.comments.create!(
        author: user,
        body: @message_body,
        public: true
      )

      ProcessedInboundMessage.create!(
        message_id: inbound_email.message_id,
        ticket: ticket,
        comment: comment
      )
    end

    if verification_token && created_user
      UserMailer.email_verification(created_user, verification_token).deliver_now
    end
  rescue InvalidDeliveryError
    bounced!
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    delivered!
  end

  def automated_or_list_mail?
    return true if mail.mime_type.to_s.downcase == "multipart/report"

    auto_submitted_values = header_values("Auto-Submitted").map { |v| v.strip.downcase }
    return true if auto_submitted_values.any? { |v| v.present? && v != "no" }

    return true if LIST_HEADERS.any? { |name| header_values(name).any?(&:present?) }

    precedence_values = header_values("Precedence").map { |v| v.strip.downcase }
    return true if precedence_values.any? { |v| AUTOMATED_PRECEDENCE_VALUES.include?(v) }

    return true if AUTO_REPLY_HEADERS.any? { |name| header_values(name).any?(&:present?) }

    if mail.header["Return-Path"].present? && header_values("Return-Path").all?(&:blank?)
      return true
    end

    from_addr = safe_from_address
    if from_addr && from_addr.local.to_s.strip.match?(AUTOMATED_LOCAL_PART_PATTERN)
      return true
    end

    false
  end

  def header_values(name)
    Array(mail.header[name]).map { |field| field.value.to_s }
  end

  def safe_from_address
    field = Array(mail.header[:from]).first
    return nil unless field

    element = field.respond_to?(:element) ? field.element : field.address_list
    element&.addresses&.first
  rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
    nil
  end

  def safe_recipient_addresses
    addresses = []

    %i[to cc bcc].each do |field_name|
      Array(mail.header[field_name]).each do |field|
        element = field.respond_to?(:element) ? field.element : field.address_list
        addresses.concat(Array(element&.addresses))
      rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
        next
      end
    end

    %i[x_original_to x_forwarded_to].each do |field_name|
      Array(mail.header[field_name]).each do |field|
        addresses << Mail::Address.new(field.to_s)
      rescue Mail::Field::ParseError
        next
      end
    end

    addresses
  end

  def extract_plain_text_body
    text = if mail.multipart?
      plain_part = find_part_by_mime_type(mail, "text/plain")
      if plain_part
        decode_part_text(plain_part)
      elsif (html_part = find_part_by_mime_type(mail, "text/html"))
        html_to_plain_text(decode_part_text(html_part))
      else
        ""
      end
    elsif mail.attachment?
      ""
    elsif mail.mime_type.nil? || mail.mime_type.downcase == "text/plain"
      decode_part_text(mail)
    elsif mail.mime_type.downcase == "text/html"
      html_to_plain_text(decode_part_text(mail))
    else
      ""
    end

    text.gsub(/\r\n?/, "\n").strip
  end

  def find_part_by_mime_type(part, target_mime_type)
    part.all_parts.find do |p|
      !p.attachment? && p.mime_type.to_s.downcase == target_mime_type
    end
  end

  def decode_part_text(part)
    raw = part.body.decoded.to_s
    charset = part.charset.presence || mail.charset.presence
    if charset && raw.encoding == Encoding::BINARY
      raw = raw.dup.force_encoding(Encoding.find(charset)) rescue raw
    end
    raw.encode("UTF-8", invalid: :replace, undef: :replace, replace: "")
  end

  def html_to_plain_text(html)
    with_breaks = html.gsub(/<\s*(?:br\s*\/?|\/p|\/div|\/li|\/tr)\s*>/i, "\n")
    stripped = ActionView::Base.full_sanitizer.sanitize(with_breaks)
    CGI.unescapeHTML(stripped.to_s)
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class HelpdeskTicketPriorityAndFiltersTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  include ActiveSupport::Testing::TimeHelpers

  setup do
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
  end

  def json_body
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def extract_token_from_last_email
    mail = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_not_nil mail
    body = mail.text_part ? mail.text_part.body.decoded : mail.body.decoded
    match = body.match(/token=([^\s&"']+)/)
    assert_not_nil match, "Expected token in email body: #{body}"
    CGI.unescape(match[1])
  end

  def create_account_and_owner(subdomain: "acme", name: "Acme", email: "jo@acme.test", admin_name: "Jo", password: "owner-password")
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: {
        account: {
          name: name,
          subdomain: subdomain,
          admin: {
            name: admin_name,
            email: email,
            password: password
          }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    owner_id = json_body.dig("user", "id")

    token = extract_token_from_last_email
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { email_verification: { token: token } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { session: { email: email, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
    [ json_body.dig("session", "token"), owner_id ]
  end

      params: { invitation: { email: email, role: "agent" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    inv_token = extract_token_from_last_email

    post "/api/v1/invitation_acceptances",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { invitation_acceptance: { token: inv_token, name: name, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    agent_id = json_body.dig("user", "id")

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { session: { email: email, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear

  end

class Invitation < ApplicationRecord
  ROLES = %w[admin agent].freeze
  STATUSES = %w[pending accepted revoked expired].freeze
  INVITATION_TTL = 7.days

  belongs_to :account, inverse_of: :invitations
  belongs_to :invited_by, class_name: "User", inverse_of: :sent_invitations

  attr_accessor :plain_token

  normalizes :email, with: ->(value) { value.strip.downcase }

  before_validation :assign_token_and_expiry, on: :create

  validates :email, presence: true, format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP }
  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ROLES }
  validates :token_digest, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :expires_at, presence: true
  validate :invited_by_belongs_to_account
  validate :no_existing_user_with_email, on: :create
  validate :no_competing_pending_invitation, on: :create

  scope :ordered_by_id, -> { order(id: :asc) }
  scope :accepted, -> { where.not(accepted_at: nil) }
  scope :revoked, -> { where(accepted_at: nil).where.not(revoked_at: nil) }
  scope :expired, -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at <= ?", Time.current) }
  scope :pending, -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at > ?", Time.current) }

  def self.digest_token(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.find_by_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    find_by(token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def accepted?
    accepted_at.present?
  end

  def revoked?
    !accepted? && revoked_at.present?
  end

  def expired?
    !accepted? && !revoked? && expires_at <= Time.current
  end

  def pending?
    !accepted? && !revoked? && expires_at > Time.current
  end

  def status
    if accepted?
      "accepted"
    elsif revoked?
      "revoked"
    elsif expired?
      "expired"
    else
      "pending"
    end
  end

  def resend!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    now = Time.current
    update!(
      token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      expires_at: now + INVITATION_TTL,
      sent_at: now
    )
    self.plain_token = raw_token
    raw_token
  end

  def revoke!
    update!(revoked_at: Time.current)
  end

  private

  def assign_token_and_expiry
    now = Time.current
    if token_digest.blank?
      raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
      self.plain_token = raw_token
      self.token_digest = self.class.digest_token(raw_token)
    end
    self.expires_at ||= now + INVITATION_TTL
    self.sent_at ||= now
  end

  def invited_by_belongs_to_account
    return if account_id.blank? || invited_by.blank?

    if invited_by.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:invited_by, "must belong to the same account")
    end
  end

  def no_existing_user_with_email
    return if account.blank? || email.blank?

    if account.users.exists?(email: email)
      errors.add(:email, "already belongs to a user in this account")
    end
  end

  def no_competing_pending_invitation
    return if account.blank? || email.blank?

    if account.invitations.pending.where.not(id: id).exists?(email: email)
      errors.add(:email, "already has a pending invitation")
    end
  end

    class MeController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!

      def show
        render json: { user: serialize_user(current_user) }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        user_params = params.require(:user).permit(:name)
        if current_user.update(user_params)
          render json: { user: serialize_user(current_user) }, status: :ok
        else
          render json: { errors: current_user.errors.messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end
      end

      def update_password
        password_params = params.require(:password_change)
        current_password = password_params[:current_password].to_s
        new_password = password_params[:password].to_s

        unless current_user.authenticate(current_password)
          render json: {
            error: "Current password is invalid",
            errors: { current_password: [ "is invalid" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        if new_password.blank?
          render json: {
            errors: { password: [ "can't be blank" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        current_user.password = new_password
        unless current_user.valid?
          render json: { errors: current_user.errors.messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        current_user.change_password!(new_password)
        render json: { message: "Password updated" }, status: :ok

require "digest"
require "securerandom"

class Invitation < ApplicationRecord
  ROLES = %w[admin agent].freeze
  STATUSES = %w[pending accepted revoked expired].freeze
  INVITATION_TTL = 7.days

  belongs_to :account, inverse_of: :invitations
  belongs_to :invited_by, class_name: "User", inverse_of: :sent_invitations

  attr_accessor :plain_token

  normalizes :email, with: ->(value) { value.strip.downcase }

  before_validation :assign_token_and_expiry, on: :create

  validates :email, presence: true, format: { with: URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP }
  validates :role, presence: true, inclusion: { in: ROLES }
  validates :token_digest, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  validates :expires_at, presence: true
  validate :invited_by_belongs_to_account
  validate :no_existing_user_with_email, on: :create
  validate :no_competing_pending_invitation, on: :create

  scope :ordered_by_id, -> { order(id: :asc) }
  scope :accepted, -> { where.not(accepted_at: nil) }
  scope :revoked, -> { where(accepted_at: nil).where.not(revoked_at: nil) }
  scope :expired, -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at <= ?", Time.current) }
  scope :pending, -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil).where("expires_at > ?", Time.current) }

  def self.digest_token(raw_token)
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(raw_token.to_s)
  end

  def self.find_by_token(raw_token)
    return nil if raw_token.blank?

    find_by(token_digest: digest_token(raw_token))
  end

  def accepted?
    accepted_at.present?
  end

  def revoked?
    !accepted? && revoked_at.present?
  end

  def expired?
    !accepted? && !revoked? && expires_at <= Time.current
  end

  def pending?
    !accepted? && !revoked? && expires_at > Time.current
  end

  def status
    if accepted?
      "accepted"
    elsif revoked?
      "revoked"
    elsif expired?
      "expired"
    else
      "pending"
    end
  end

  def resend!
    raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    now = Time.current
    update!(
      token_digest: self.class.digest_token(raw_token),
      expires_at: now + INVITATION_TTL,
      sent_at: now
    )
    self.plain_token = raw_token
    raw_token
  end

  def revoke!
    update!(revoked_at: Time.current)
  end

  private

  def assign_token_and_expiry
    now = Time.current
    if token_digest.blank?
      raw_token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
      self.plain_token = raw_token
      self.token_digest = self.class.digest_token(raw_token)
    end
    self.expires_at ||= now + INVITATION_TTL
    self.sent_at ||= now
  end

  def invited_by_belongs_to_account
    return if account_id.blank? || invited_by.blank?

    if invited_by.account_id != account_id
      errors.add(:invited_by, "must belong to the same account")
    end
  end

  def no_existing_user_with_email
    return if account.blank? || email.blank?

    if account.users.exists?(email: email)
      errors.add(:email, "already belongs to a user in this account")
    end
  end

  def no_competing_pending_invitation
    return if account.blank? || email.blank?

    if account.invitations.pending.where.not(id: id).exists?(email: email)
      errors.add(:email, "already has a pending invitation")
    end
  end
end

module Api

      before_action :require_account!
      before_action :require_active_account!
      before_action :authenticate_user!

      def show
        render json: { user: serialize_user(current_user) }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        user_params = params.require(:user).permit(:name)
        if current_user.update(user_params)
          render json: { user: serialize_user(current_user) }, status: :ok
        else
          render json: { errors: current_user.errors.messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end
      end

      def update_password
        password_params = params.require(:password_change)
        current_password = password_params[:current_password].to_s
        new_password = password_params[:password].to_s

        unless current_user.authenticate(current_password)
          render json: {
            error: "Current password is invalid",
            errors: { current_password: [ "is invalid" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        if new_password.blank?
          render json: {
            errors: { password: [ "can't be blank" ] }
          }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        current_user.password = new_password
        unless current_user.valid?
          render json: { errors: current_user.errors.messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        current_user.change_password!(new_password)
        render json: { message: "Password updated" }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end

module Api

    class AccountsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!, except: :create
      before_action :require_active_account!, only: %i[show cancel]
      before_action :authenticate_user!, except: :create
      before_action :require_admin!, only: %i[cancel reactivate]

      def create
        account_params = params.require(:account)
        admin_params = account_params.require(:admin)

        account = Account.new(
          name: account_params[:name],
          subdomain: account_params[:subdomain]
        )
        user = account.users.build(
          name: admin_params[:name],
          email: admin_params[:email],
          password: admin_params[:password],
          role: "admin",
          verified: false
        )

        verification_token = nil
        valid = false

        Account.transaction do
          account_valid = account.valid?
          user_valid = user.valid?

          if account_valid && user_valid
            account.save!
            user.save!
            verification_token = user.generate_email_verification_token!
            valid = true
          else
            raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
          end
        end

        if valid
          UserMailer.email_verification(user, verification_token).deliver_now
          render json: {
            account: serialize_account(account),
            user: serialize_user(user)
          }, status: :created
        else
          errors = {}
          errors[:account] = account.errors.messages if account.errors.any?
          errors[:admin] = user.errors.messages if user.errors.any?
          render json: { errors: errors }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end
      end

      def show
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account) }, status: :ok
      end

      def cancel
        current_account.cancel!
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account.reload) }, status: :ok
      end

      def reactivate
        unless current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is not cancelled" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        unless current_account.within_reactivation_window?
          render json: { error: "Account reactivation window has expired" }, status: :forbidden
          return
        end

        current_account.reactivate!
        render json: { account: serialize_account(current_account.reload) }, status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end

First, the RESTful fundamentals: `sessions#destroy` returns `head :no_content`, and that's the standard for deletion; we'll keep that consistency.  Now, the `serialize_group(group)` method:  We need a clean, consistent set of attributes here.  We're going to include `id`, `account_id`, `name`, `created_at`, and `updated_at`.  This matches the pattern used elsewhere.

2.  **User inclusion**:
    *   Staff members *within* the current account are the only ones.  Validation will ensure this, and invalid IDs are caught by validations returning 422.
    *   Staff members *must* be staff (`user.staff?`).
    *   Suspension is *key*:  "Suspension keeps memberships for later."  If a staff member is suspended, the memberships are KEPT, but ticket assignments are cleared as before.

    Now, regarding the nuances of "suspended":

    *   What happens if we *add* a suspended user? We need to keep in mind,  `Ticket` validates if an assignee is suspended. So, it's not explicitly stated in the prompt whether we're going to allow adding a suspended user.  It says "Suspension keeps memberships for later", but it doesn't say if we're rejecting suspended users. Considering existing code, and the use of the word "later", the best bet would be to be lenient about that, and allow it, but validate the member's details.

    Let's think about this: In `UsersController`, the `staff` endpoint excludes those `.active`.  But the prompt does not say the same, only the `TicketsController`.  If we reject a suspended user from `POST /group_memberships`, tests may be broken, especially those that include the steps of suspending a user in a particular state.  This would violate the "Suspension keeps memberships for later" rule. So we'll allow that.

    Key considerations:  We will keep validations in mind:
    *   `user` must exist and belong to the same `account` as the `group`.
    *   `user` must be staff.
    *   `group` must exist and belong to the `account`.
    *   `group_id, user_id` must be unique.

    *   A staff member with NO memberships:  the *first* membership *must* automatically become the `default`. This is the invariant.

class GroupMembership < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account, inverse_of: :group_memberships
  belongs_to :group, inverse_of: :group_memberships
  belongs_to :user, inverse_of: :group_memberships

  before_validation :assign_account_from_group
  before_validation :assign_initial_default, on: :create

  validates :default, inclusion: { in: [ true, false ] }
  validates :user_id, uniqueness: { scope: :group_id }
  validate :group_belongs_to_account
  validate :user_must_be_staff_in_account

  before_create :clear_previous_default_if_needed
  before_destroy :clear_invalid_ticket_assignments
  after_destroy :ensure_remaining_default_membership

  scope :ordered_by_id, -> { order(id: :asc) }
  scope :default_memberships, -> { where(default: true) }

  def make_default!
    transaction do
      account.lock!
      reload
      user.group_memberships.where.not(id: id).where(default: true).update_all(default: false)
      update!(default: true) unless default?
    end
  end

  private

  def assign_account_from_group
    self.account_id ||= group&.account_id
  end

  def assign_initial_default
    self.default = false if default.nil?
    return if user.blank?

    if user.group_memberships.where.not(id: id).none?
      self.default = true
    end
  end

  def clear_previous_default_if_needed
    return unless default? && user_id.present?

    GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id, default: true).update_all(default: false)
  end

  def clear_invalid_ticket_assignments
    Ticket.where(account_id: account_id, group_id: group_id, assignee_id: user_id).update_all(assignee_id: nil)
  end

  def ensure_remaining_default_membership
    return if destroyed_by_association.present?
    return unless default?
    return if GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id, default: true).exists?

    replacement = GroupMembership.where(user_id: user_id).ordered_by_id.first
    replacement&.update_column(:default, true)
  end

  def group_belongs_to_account
    return if group_id.blank?

    if group.nil? || (account_id.present? && group.account_id != account_id)
      errors.add(:group_id, "must belong to this account")
    end
  end

  def user_must_be_staff_in_account
    return if user_id.blank?

    if user.nil? || (account_id.present? && user.account_id != account_id) || !user.staff?
      errors.add(:user_id, "must be a staff member in this account")
    end
  end
end

              @user.group_memberships.delete_all
            end

            updated = true
          else
            error_payload = { errors: @user.errors.messages }
            raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
          end
        end

        if updated
          render json: { user: serialize_user(@user.reload) }, status: :ok
        else
          render json: error_payload, status: :unprocessable_entity

require "test_helper"

class GroupMembershipTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "validates staff in same account, uniqueness per group, and default invariants" do
    acme = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    beta = Account.create!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta")

    agent = acme.users.create!(name: "Sam", email: "sam@acme.test", password: "password123", role: "agent", verified: true)
    customer = acme.users.create!(name: "Avery", email: "avery@acme.test", password: "password123", role: "customer", verified: true)
    beta_agent = beta.users.create!(name: "Bob", email: "bob@beta.test", password: "password123", role: "agent", verified: true)

    billing = acme.groups.create!(name: "Billing")
    support = acme.groups.create!(name: "Technical Support")
    beta_group = beta.groups.create!(name: "Billing")

    # Customer rejected
    cust_mem = acme.group_memberships.build(group: billing, user: customer)
    assert_not cust_mem.valid?

    # Cross-account user rejected
    cross_user = acme.group_memberships.build(group: billing, user: beta_agent)
    assert_not cross_user.valid?

    # Cross-account group rejected
    cross_group = acme.group_memberships.build(group: beta_group, user: agent)
    assert_not cross_group.valid?

    # First membership automatically becomes default even if default: false
    m1 = acme.group_memberships.create!(group: billing, user: agent, default: false)
    assert m1.default?

    # Duplicate membership rejected
    dup = acme.group_memberships.build(group: billing, user: agent)
    assert_not dup.valid?

    # Second membership defaults to false
    m2 = acme.group_memberships.create!(group: support, user: agent)
    assert_not m2.default?
    assert m1.reload.default?

    # Making m2 default flips m1
    m2.make_default!
    assert m2.reload.default?
    assert_not m1.reload.default?

    # Destroying m2 promotes m1 back to default
    m2.destroy!
    assert m1.reload.default?
  end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

    JSON.parse(response.body)

    mail = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_not_nil mail
    body = mail.text_part ? mail.text_part.body.decoded : mail.body.decoded
    match = body.match(/token=([^\s&"']+)/)
    assert_not_nil match, "Expected token in email body: #{body}"
    CGI.unescape(match[1])
  end

          subdomain: subdomain,
          admin: {
            name: admin_name,
            email: email,
            password: password
          }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    owner_id = json_body.dig("user", "id")

    token = extract_token_from_last_email
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { email_verification: { token: token } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { session: { email: email, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
    [ json_body.dig("session", "token"), owner_id ]
  end

I'll use `prepend: true` and `group_memberships.reset` in `Group` and re-run the tests.
messages.thinking:
**A Deep Dive into a Test Failure and ActiveRecord Callbacks**

Alright, that test failure just saved us, it unearthed a real bug in `Group#cleanup_tickets_and_memberships`! I need to dig into this. Let's look at the code for this method: it's updating tickets and then deleting group memberships. The issue seems to be around how `group_memberships` is handled. It looks like it uses a `has_many :group_memberships, dependent: :destroy` association. I immediately see the potential problem: if `group_memberships` is already empty when `pluck(:user_id)` runs, we won't capture the `affected_user_ids`. That would be bad, very bad.

The test, specifically line 336, shows that `m_sam_billing` was marked as `default: true`. The `delete` call on the `/api/v1/groups` endpoint calls `@group.destroy!`. So, the question becomes: does `before_destroy :cleanup_tickets_and_memberships` run before or after `dependent: :destroy`? And the answer is: `dependent: :destroy` gets registered as a `before_destroy` callback BEFORE any other `before_destroy` defined *after* the `has_many`. This means `dependent: :destroy` is running first, wiping out the `group_memberships` before we can grab the `affected_user_ids`. Brilliant catch by the integration test!

The solution? I'm thinking either prepending our callback: `before_destroy :cleanup_tickets_and_memberships, prepend: true` or completely removing the `dependent: :destroy` from the `has_many` association since the cleanup method deletes everything anyway.

Let's trace both scenarios. With `prepend: true`, `cleanup_tickets_and_memberships` runs first. We'd update tickets, grab Sam's ID, and then delete all memberships. Then `dependent: :destroy` comes along, but `group_memberships` is already empty. This scenario is interesting since there is a call to `group_memberships.reload` during the `dependent: :destroy` execution. This might mean the associations are cached and are not correctly refreshed with the database state. So, removing `dependent: :destroy` entirely seems safer!

Alternatively, if we remove `dependent: :destroy`, we still have the database FK `on_delete: :cascade`. We let `cleanup_tickets_and_memberships` handle the deletion and let the DB take care of the cascade, that seems more performant and cleaner! The only situation where `destroy` is not called is when a `delete_all` is called on the model itself. However, no controller is calling `delete_all` on `Group`, so we're good.

I'm leaning towards removing `dependent: :destroy` to keep it clean. Time to update the code in `app/models/group.rb` and rerun the tests.

cd /app && cat <<'EOF' > app/models/group.rb
class Group < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account, inverse_of: :groups
  has_many :group_memberships, dependent: :destroy, inverse_of: :group
  has_many :users, through: :group_memberships
  has_many :tickets, inverse_of: :group

  normalizes :name, with: ->(value) { value.strip }

  validates :name,
    presence: true,
    uniqueness: { scope: :account_id, case_sensitive: false }

  before_destroy :cleanup_tickets_and_memberships, prepend: true

  scope :ordered_by_id, -> { order(id: :asc) }

  private

  def cleanup_tickets_and_memberships
    Ticket.where(account_id: account_id, group_id: id).update_all(group_id: nil, assignee_id: nil)
    affected_user_ids = group_memberships.where(default: true).pluck(:user_id)
    group_memberships.delete_all
    group_memberships.reset

    affected_user_ids.each do |uid|
      next if GroupMembership.where(user_id: uid, default: true).exists?

      replacement = GroupMembership.where(user_id: uid).ordered_by_id.first
      replacement&.update_column(:default, true)
    end
  end
end

require "test_helper"
require "rake"

class PurgeCancelledAccountsTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    Rails.application.load_tasks if Rake::Task.tasks.empty?
  end

  test "purge_cancelled_accounts deletes accounts cancelled over 90 days ago and all their data" do
    active = Account.create!(name: "Active Co", subdomain: "active")
    active.users.create!(name: "A", email: "a@active.test", password: "password123", verified: true)

    recent_cancelled = Account.create!(name: "Recent Co", subdomain: "recent", cancelled_at: 89.days.ago)
    recent_user = recent_cancelled.users.create!(name: "R", email: "r@recent.test", password: "password123", verified: true)
    recent_user.sessions.create!

    old_cancelled = Account.create!(name: "Old Co", subdomain: "old", cancelled_at: 91.days.ago)
    old_user = old_cancelled.users.create!(name: "O", email: "o@old.test", password: "password123", verified: true)
    old_user.sessions.create!

    Rake::Task["helpdesk:purge_cancelled_accounts"].reenable
    assert_output(/Purged 1 cancelled account/) do
      Rake::Task["helpdesk:purge_cancelled_accounts"].invoke
    end

    assert Account.exists?(active.id)
    assert Account.exists?(recent_cancelled.id)
    assert User.exists?(recent_user.id)
